chunks: And you see the people entering into the religion of God in crowds.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people enter God's religion in crowds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Bayyinah is often interpreted as a sign of the ultimate triumph of truth, particularly associated with the emergence of the Mahdi (aj), where diverse groups unite under the pure monotheism of Islam. It underscores the divine promise that falsehood will be eradicated, leading to a universal acceptance of the faith in the end times. This mass conversion signifies not just numerical growth, but the spiritual purification of humanity under the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt.
